quote: The driver of a vehicle about to enter or exit a controlled-access highway shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on the highway whose proximity constitutes an immediate hazard and shall continue to yield the right-of-way to that traffic until the driver may proceed with reasonable safety.

activation.condition: The driver is about to exit a controlled-access highway into a general-road connection.

obligation.description: Yield right-of-way to all approaching highway vehicles whose proximity is an immediate hazard and continue yielding until reasonable safety.

timing.description: Observe all approaching vehicles and ego yielding through original exit interaction entry.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: whose proximity constitutes an immediate hazard
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original approaching vehicle occupancy, range, speed and interaction traces need human review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: until the driver may proceed with reasonable safety
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original ego wait and exit entry joined to every approaching vehicle need human review.

parameter_refs.name: exit_policy
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: yield until clear, proceed before clear, or proceed between vehicles

parameter_refs.name: approach_headway_s
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 3 or 9 seconds engineering probes, not legal cutoffs
